title: IP address allocation via NAS signalling

entities.name: UE requested PDN connectivity procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to establish PDN connectivity, involving sending PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST and receiving ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST.

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message sent by the UE to request PDN connectivity, containing PDN type IE and Protocol Configuration Options IE.

entities.name: ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message sent by the network to activate the default EPS bearer context, containing PDN type and PDN address information.

entities.name: PDN type
entities.description: IE indicating the requested PDN type (IPv4, IPv6, IPv4v6, non-IP, Ethernet). Set by UE in PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST and by network in ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST.

entities.name: Protocol Configuration Options
entities.description: IE used by the UE to indicate the use of DHCPv4 for IPv4 address assignment in PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST.

entities.name: PDN address
entities.description: IE containing PDN type and PDN address information, included by network in ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST.

entities.name: UE IP capability condition
entities.description: Condition based on UE's IP stack capability (IPv4-only, IPv6-only, IPv4v6, unknown) determining PDN type IE setting in PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST.

entities.name: Subscription limitation condition
entities.description: Condition where subscription limits PDN type to IPv4-only or IPv6-only, causing network to override UE's requested PDN type.

entities.name: PDN GW configuration condition
entities.description: Condition where PDN GW configuration dictates single IP version addressing, causing network to override UE's requested PDN type.

entities.name: Single address bearers condition
entities.description: Condition where operator uses single addressing per bearer, causing network to override PDN type and set ESM cause #52.

entities.name: Network overrides PDN type
entities.description: Network behavior to override UE's requested PDN type based on subscription, PDN GW configuration, or single address bearer policy.

entities.name: UE restriction on reconnection
entities.description: UE shall not initiate another PDN connectivity procedure to same APN for different PDN type until PLMN change, switch off, or USIM removal.

relations.description: UE requested PDN connectivity procedure includes sending PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message.
UE requested PDN connectivity procedure includes receiving ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.
PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message contains PDN type IE.
PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message contains Protocol Configuration Options IE.
ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message contains PDN address IE.
PDN type IE setting is guarded by UE IP capability condition.
Subscription limitation condition establishes network override of PDN type.
PDN GW configuration condition establishes network override of PDN type.
Single address bearers condition establishes network override of PDN type.
Network override of PDN type establishes UE restriction on reconnection to same APN.
